title: Which parts of Explanatory Construction Semantics 2.0 a model's reading of six of its stated points depends on

charter.purpose: Find, with no key and no declared dependencies, which units of the ECS 2.0 document a model's answer about one of the document's own stated points depends on: each headed unit at levels 1 and 2 is removed in turn with everything else present, and the reply is compared with the same model's reply on the full document. The units, the terms, and each unit's relation to the claim (the section the claim is drawn from, a definition that section uses, or neither) are computed from the document by pattern; the six claims are statements drawn from named sections, given in probes.json.
charter.output: Per-model observation and run records in which every field is recorded and none is scored, plus the dependence table: removals by relation beside the repeat floor, and the model's own named dependencies beside what removal moved.
scope_in: One markdown document of about four hundred and sixty lines, read whole in every call.
Six probes, each a statement drawn from a named section (probes.json); the section is the probe's self unit.
Every headed unit at levels 1 and 2 removed once per probe; two repeats of every baseline.
scope_out: Any answer key: no reply is judged right or wrong, and the run label is always the no-scored-output one.
Any claim that the document's argument is sound or that a model understands it; a moved reply criticises the model, the document as sent, and the choice of units and claim together.
Ranking models, scoring them, or declaring any model fit for use.
